mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 28 degrees, overcast, and we have a full moon above Verona Community Park.

Tax season is approaching, so watch for your property tax bills arriving by December 15. You can pay in two installments, with the first due by January 31 at the City Center or online, and the second due in July to Dane County.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look out for Trivia at The Bogey Factory and Art House 360 events.
Reviewing the latest department reports, on November 2, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on West End Circle which resulted in an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
